s.n: Psyduck's sweet corn fritters with avocado smash
s.note: Golden sweet corn fritters, lime avocado smash spooned on top.
s.how: Whisk the flour, eggs and milk into a thick batter, then stir in the corn, spring onion, cheese and a pinch of salt. Mash the avocados with the lime juice and a little salt. Fry heaped spoonfuls in the oil until golden, about 2 minutes a side. Drain and serve with the avocado smash.

s.n: Mr Mime's grilled cheese with tomato soup shots
s.note: Toasted cheese fingers, little cups of tomato soup.
s.how: Soften the onion in the oil, add the tomatoes, stock and sugar and simmer for 15 minutes. Blend until smooth, stir in the cream and season. Fill the bread with cheese, butter the outsides and toast in a pan until golden and melted. Cut into fingers and serve with small cups of soup for dipping.

m.n: Hi-Hat Cafe fried chicken and waffles with maple butter
m.note: Buttermilk fried chicken on crisp waffles, maple butter melting over.
m.how: Soak the chicken in 375ml buttermilk with a pinch of salt for at least 20 minutes. Whisk the waffle flour, baking powder, eggs, 250ml buttermilk and melted butter and cook in a hot waffle iron until crisp. Toss the chicken in the flour mixed with paprika, garlic powder and salt, and fry at 175C until golden and cooked through. Beat the soft butter with the maple syrup. Stack the chicken on the waffles, top with maple butter and pour over extra syrup.
shop: 150g plain flour, plus 200g for the waffles@Pantry
3 tbsp maple syrup, plus extra to serve@Pantry

m.n: Charizard's flame-grilled beef skewers with rice
m.note: Sticky soy beef skewers, rice, crunchy slaw.
m.how: Mix the soy, honey, sesame oil and garlic, toss with the beef and leave for 15 minutes. Cook the rice. Thread the beef and capsicum onto the skewers. Grill on a hot barbecue or grill pan, turning, until charred and sticky, brushing with the leftover marinade. Toss the cabbage and carrot with lime juice and serve with the skewers and rice.

w.n: Sweet Mother of Arceus lemon sundae
w.note: Vanilla ice cream, lemon curd, honeycomb bolts.
w.how: Whip the cream to soft peaks. Layer crushed biscuits, ice cream and lemon curd in 4 tall glasses. Top with cream and stick in shards of honeycomb like lightning bolts.

d.note: Espresso, hot chocolate and steamed milk, kids skip the coffee.
d.how: Heat the milk until steaming and whisk in the drinking chocolate. Pour a shot of espresso into each grown-up mug, top up with the chocolate milk and finish with cream and a dusting of cocoa.
shop: 4 shots espresso, or 4 tsp instant coffee@Pantry
